name: Optimize!
description: Manao is solving a problem with the following statement: He came up with a solution that produces the correct answers but is too slow. You are given the pseudocode of his solution, where the function getAnswer calculates the answer to the problem: getAnswer(a[1..n], b[1..len], h) answer = 0 for i = 1 to n-len+1 answer = answer + f(a[i..i+len-1], b, h, 1) return answer f(s[1..len], b[1..len], h, index) if index = len+1 then return 1 for i = 1 to len if s[index] + b[i] >= h mem = b[i] b[i] = 0 res = f(s, b, h, index + 1) b[i] = mem if res > 0 return 1 return 0 Your task is to help Manao optimize his algorithm.
input_specification: The first line contains space-separated integers n , len and h ( 1 ≤ len ≤ n ≤ 150000; 1 ≤ h ≤ 10 9 ). The second line contains len space-separated integers b 1 , b 2 , ..., b len ( 1 ≤ b i ≤ 10 9 ). The third line contains n space-separated integers a 1 , a 2 , ..., a n ( 1 ≤ a i ≤ 10 9 ).
output_specification: Print a single number — the answer to Manao's problem.
approach_summary: Build a Segment Tree over the array. Implement point update and associative range query operations in O(log N) time per query.
